title: Elf Bar ElfLiq Kiwi Passionfruit Guava Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Kiwi Passionfruit Guava from ElfLiq’s range of nic salt e-liquids delivers a rush of tropical flavour from your very first vape. Sharp kiwi, rich passionfruit and tangy guava are an irresistible combination that is indescribably delicious, especially lovers of beguiling fruit blends. Elfliq e-liquids are Elf Bar’s most iconic flavours in 10ml bottles of nicotine salt e-liquid. With a 50% VG / 50% PG concentration, Elfliq liquids produce a discreet amount of flavour-rich vapour with a smooth, comfortable throat hit, and provide rapid relief from nicotine cravings. Elfliq nicotine salt e-liquids are available in 10mg or 20mg nicotine strength and are ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. Crafted for refillable vapes and vape starter kit UK users seeking simple, satisfying vaping.
